WITH sales_by_city_category AS (
    SELECT p."Product_Category" AS "Product_Category", s."Store_City" AS "Store_City",
           SUM(t."Units" * NULLIF(regexp_replace(p."Product_Price", '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric) AS "Total_Sales"
    FROM toy_sales t
    JOIN toy_products p ON t."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
    JOIN toy_stores s ON t."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID"
    GROUP BY p."Product_Category", s."Store_City"
),
category_avg AS (
    SELECT "Product_Category", AVG("Total_Sales") AS "Avg_Sales"
    FROM sales_by_city_category
    GROUP BY "Product_Category"
)
SELECT sc."Product_Category", sc."Store_City", sc."Total_Sales"
FROM sales_by_city_category sc
JOIN category_avg ca ON sc."Product_Category" = ca."Product_Category"
WHERE sc."Total_Sales" > ca."Avg_Sales"
ORDER BY sc."Product_Category", sc."Store_City";

cases.first_sql: WITH sales_profit AS (SELECT pr."Product_Category", st."Store_City", (CAST(TRIM(REPLACE(pr."Product_Price", '$', '')) AS DECIMAL) - CAST(TRIM(REPLACE(pr."Product_Cost", '$', '')) AS DECIMAL)) * CAST(s."Units" AS INT) AS profit FROM toy_sales AS s JOIN toy_stores AS st ON s."Store_ID" = st."Store_ID" JOIN toy_products AS pr ON s."Product_ID" = pr."Product_ID"), city_sales AS (SELECT "Product_Category", "Store_City", SUM(CAST(TRIM(REPLACE(pr."Product_Price", '$', '')) AS DECIMAL) * CAST(s."Units" AS INT)) AS total_sales FROM toy_sales AS s JOIN toy_stores AS st ON s."Store_ID" = st."Store_ID" JOIN toy_products AS pr ON s."Product_ID" = pr."Product_ID" GROUP BY "Product_Category", "Store_City"), city_rank AS (SELECT "Product_Category", "Store_City", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Product_Category" ORDER BY total_sales DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM city_sales), top_cities AS (SELECT "Product_Category", "Store_City" FROM city_rank WHERE rank <= 3) SELECT sp."Product_Category" AS "product_category", SUM(sp.profit) AS "total_profit" FROM sales_profit AS sp JOIN top_cities AS tc ON sp."Product_Category" = tc."Product_Category" AND sp."Store_City" = tc."Store_City" GROUP BY sp."Product_Category"

cases.first_sql: WITH product_clean AS (SELECT "Product_ID" AS "Product_ID", "Product_Category" AS "Product_Category", CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE("Product_Price", '$', ''), ' ', ''), ',', '') AS REAL) AS product_price_num FROM toy_products WHERE NOT "Product_Price" IS NULL AND "Product_Price" <> ''), category_stats AS (SELECT "Product_Category", AVG(product_price_num) AS avg_price FROM product_clean GROUP BY "Product_Category"), competitiveness_ranking AS (SELECT pc."Product_ID", pc."Product_Category", pc.product_price_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc."Product_Category" ORDER BY pc.product_price_num ASC NULLS FIRST, pc."Product_ID" ASC NULLS FIRST) AS rank_result FROM product_clean AS pc JOIN category_stats AS cs ON pc."Product_Category" = cs."Product_Category") SELECT "Product_ID", "Product_Category", product_price_num AS "Product_Price", rank_result AS competitiveness_rank FROM competitiveness_ranking WHERE rank_result <= 5 ORDER BY "Product_Category" NULLS FIRST, rank_result NULLS FIRST
cases.final_sql: WITH product_clean AS (SELECT "Product_ID" AS "Product_ID", "Product_Category" AS "Product_Category", CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE("Product_Price", '$', ''), ' ', ''), ',', '') AS REAL) AS product_price_num FROM toy_products WHERE NOT "Product_Price" IS NULL AND "Product_Price" <> ''), category_stats AS (SELECT "Product_Category", AVG(product_price_num) AS avg_price FROM product_clean GROUP BY "Product_Category"), competitiveness_ranking AS (SELECT pc."Product_ID", pc."Product_Category", pc.product_price_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc."Product_Category" ORDER BY pc.product_price_num ASC NULLS FIRST, pc."Product_ID" ASC NULLS FIRST) AS rank_result FROM product_clean AS pc JOIN category_stats AS cs ON pc."Product_Category" = cs."Product_Category") SELECT "Product_ID", "Product_Category", product_price_num AS "Product_Price", rank_result AS competitiveness_rank FROM competitiveness_ranking WHERE rank_result <= 5 ORDER BY "Product_Category" NULLS FIRST, rank_result NULLS FIRST

cases.first_sql: WITH product_profit AS (SELECT "Product_ID", CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("Product_Price", '$', ''), ' ', '') AS REAL) - CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("Product_Cost", '$', ''), ' ', '') AS REAL) AS profit FROM toy_products), high_profit_products AS (SELECT "Product_ID" FROM product_profit WHERE profit > 5), valid_inventory AS (SELECT i."Store_ID", i."Stock_On_Hand", i."Product_ID" FROM toy_inventory AS i INNER JOIN high_profit_products AS h ON i."Product_ID" = h."Product_ID"), city_stocks AS (SELECT s."Store_City", CAST(v."Stock_On_Hand" AS INT) AS stock FROM valid_inventory AS v INNER JOIN toy_stores AS s ON v."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID") SELECT "Store_City" AS "Store_City", SUM(stock) AS total_stock FROM city_stocks GROUP BY "Store_City"
cases.final_sql: WITH product_profit AS (SELECT "Product_ID", CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("Product_Price", '$', ''), ' ', '') AS REAL) - CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("Product_Cost", '$', ''), ' ', '') AS REAL) AS profit FROM toy_products), high_profit_products AS (SELECT "Product_ID" FROM product_profit WHERE profit > 5), valid_inventory AS (SELECT i."Store_ID", i."Stock_On_Hand", i."Product_ID" FROM toy_inventory AS i INNER JOIN high_profit_products AS h ON i."Product_ID" = h."Product_ID"), city_stocks AS (SELECT s."Store_City", CAST(v."Stock_On_Hand" AS INT) AS stock FROM valid_inventory AS v INNER JOIN toy_stores AS s ON v."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID") SELECT "Store_City" AS "Store_City", SUM(stock) AS total_stock FROM city_stocks GROUP BY "Store_City"

cases.first_sql: select result."Store_ID", nullif(result.total_sales, 'NULL')::numeric as total_sales, nullif(result.avg_stock, 'NULL')::numeric as avg_stock from (WITH sales_summary /* 计算每个店铺的总销量 */ AS (SELECT "Store_ID", CAST(SUM("Units") AS TEXT) AS total_sales FROM toy_sales GROUP BY "Store_ID"), inventory_avg /* 计算每个店铺的平均库存量 */ AS (SELECT "Store_ID", CAST(AVG("Stock_On_Hand") AS TEXT) AS avg_stock FROM toy_inventory GROUP BY "Store_ID") /* 全连接并输出所有店铺的三个字段，过滤掉两个字段都为NULL的记录 */ SELECT CAST(st."Store_ID" AS TEXT) AS "Store_ID", COALESCE(ss.total_sales, 'NULL') AS total_sales, COALESCE(ia.avg_stock, 'NULL') AS avg_stock FROM toy_stores AS st LEFT JOIN sales_summary AS ss ON ss."Store_ID" = st."Store_ID" LEFT JOIN inventory_avg AS ia ON st."Store_ID" = ia."Store_ID" WHERE NOT ss.total_sales IS NULL OR NOT ia.avg_stock IS NULL ORDER BY st."Store_ID" NULLS FIRST) as result
cases.final_sql: select result."Store_ID", nullif(result.total_sales, 'NULL')::numeric as total_sales, nullif(result.avg_stock, 'NULL')::numeric as avg_stock from (WITH sales_summary /* 计算每个店铺的总销量 */ AS (SELECT "Store_ID", CAST(SUM("Units") AS TEXT) AS total_sales FROM toy_sales GROUP BY "Store_ID"), inventory_avg /* 计算每个店铺的平均库存量 */ AS (SELECT "Store_ID", CAST(AVG("Stock_On_Hand") AS TEXT) AS avg_stock FROM toy_inventory GROUP BY "Store_ID") /* 全连接并输出所有店铺的三个字段，过滤掉两个字段都为NULL的记录 */ SELECT CAST(st."Store_ID" AS TEXT) AS "Store_ID", COALESCE(ss.total_sales, 'NULL') AS total_sales, COALESCE(ia.avg_stock, 'NULL') AS avg_stock FROM toy_stores AS st LEFT JOIN sales_summary AS ss ON ss."Store_ID" = st."Store_ID" LEFT JOIN inventory_avg AS ia ON st."Store_ID" = ia."Store_ID" WHERE NOT ss.total_sales IS NULL OR NOT ia.avg_stock IS NULL ORDER BY st."Store_ID" NULLS FIRST) as result

cases.first_sql: WITH stores_residential AS (SELECT "Store_ID" FROM toy_stores WHERE "Store_Location" = 'Downtown'), sales_joined AS (SELECT s."Product_ID", CAST(s."Units" AS BIGINT) AS "Units" FROM toy_sales AS s JOIN stores_residential AS sr ON s."Store_ID" = sr."Store_ID"), product_sales AS (SELECT "Product_ID", SUM("Units") AS total_units FROM sales_joined GROUP BY "Product_ID" HAVING SUM("Units") < 3), sales_ranked AS (SELECT "Product_ID", total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_units DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM product_sales) SELECT p."Product_Name" AS "产品名称", sr.total_units AS "总销量" FROM sales_ranked AS sr JOIN toy_products AS p ON sr."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID" WHERE rn <= 2
